title: VK-only Write Single Coil
purpose: Exercise a conservative single-request write state using an issue-related unit-test-server context and a standard single-coil request shape.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the request and normally return the corresponding Write Single Coil response; harnesses may observe rejection or connection failure depending on server state.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus six-byte request body.
Function code 05 and coil value ff00 form a recognizable request.
issue_safety_notes: This is a valid structural analogue and does not reproduce the documented issue payload. The issue describes suspected pointer lifetime or backend-state behavior, not a confirmed root cause.
